crossRefs.note: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘These are the living things which you may eat among all the animals that are…
ten head of fat cattle, twenty head of cattle out of the pastures, and one hundred sheep, in addition to deer, and…

translations.web: These are the animals which you may eat: the ox, the sheep, the goat,
translations.bsb: These are the animals that you may eat: The ox, the sheep, the goat,
translations.kjv: These are the beasts which ye shall eat: the ox, the sheep, and the goat,
translations.asv: These are the beasts which ye may eat: the ox, the sheep, and the goat,
